en: A colorized historical postcard view of a German town square labeled as the marketplace. It shows a broad, curved market square with trees and unpaved ground, a woman walking and a horse‑drawn cart. Surrounding the square are multi‑story buildings with German signage, including hotels and municipal offices. The central building has a clock above the entrance and carries institutional inscriptions.
